name: Premium Copper Grease

ad.description: Creates a protective shield against rust, oxidation, and various types of corrosion, extending the life of brake components. Premium copper grease works effectively in both high and low-temperature conditions, making it an ideal lubricant for brake shims and contact points between pads and hardware, ensuring optimal performance.

Excellent high-temperature protection and moisture resistance.
